Dengue.transmission: Mosquito bite (Aedes aegypti breeding in stagnant water)
Dengue.advisory: Avoid mosquito bites, apply repellents, remove standing water around households.

symptoms: High fever with chills and rigors
Malaria.transmission: Mosquito bite (Anopheles vector breeding in clean standing water)
Malaria.advisory: Use insecticide-treated bed nets, spray vector breeding zones, use repellents.

Cholera.transmission: Ingestion of water or food contaminated with Vibrio cholerae
Cholera.advisory: Drink only boiled or purified water, maintain strict hand hygiene, eat cooked food.

Gastroenteritis.transmission: Fecal-oral route via contaminated water supply or unhygienic food
Gastroenteritis.advisory: Use water purification tablets, boil drinking water, ensure food safety.

SARI_Flu.transmission: Airborne respiratory droplets and fine aerosol transmission
SARI_Flu.advisory: Wear N95/surgical masks in crowded areas, ensure indoor ventilation, practice cough hygiene.

AQI_Strain.transmission: Environmental inhalation of fine particulate matter (PM2.5, PM10, smog)
AQI_Strain.advisory: Limit outdoor exposure during peak AQI hours, run indoor air purifiers, wear N95 filter masks.

symptoms: Hot dry skin or heavy sweating
Heatstroke_Dehydration.transmission: Extreme thermal environmental stress and prolonged direct solar exposure
Heatstroke_Dehydration.incubation: Acute onset within hours of heat exposure
Heatstroke_Dehydration.advisory: Stay hydrated with ORS/electrolytes, avoid direct sunlight between 11 AM - 4 PM, rest in shaded areas.
